tests.name: Landscape +90 and -90 physical roll retain optical forward
Alpha wrap and multi-turn yaw remain continuous
Tilted comfortable calibration preserves yaw about gravity
Unrestricted inverse calibration demonstrably breaks gravity yaw
Pitch clamp, zero roll and output quaternion convention
Pole yaw hold and hysteresis suppress unstable heading
Opposite-heading pole exit is continuous and next delta works
Pole calibration rejects and target calibration sets shadow follow pose
180-degree screen-angle change retains accumulated yaw and pitch
Resume with changed sensor reference retains displayed orientation
Invalid samples rejected without corrupting state

benchmark.kind: CPU-only coordinate math; excludes sensor cadence, rendering, input-to-photon latency and mobile thermal effects

limitations: Relative alpha can drift; this does not establish geographic north.
Unwrap assumes less than 180 degrees of heading motion between accepted non-pole samples.
At vertical optical direction yaw is undefined; hold policy deliberately cannot infer turns made at the pole.
Fresh sample rebasing requires lifecycle gating in a future integration.
No production input, permissions, lifecycle or renderer implementation is included.
